title: Compatible scalar thickening sections determine one power series
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], d>0, B=A[[x_1,...,x_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], f:B→A constant coefficient and I=ker(f). Let V⊂Spec(B) be open whose zero-section inverse image is the punctured spectrum of A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put V_n=V×_{Spec(B)}Spec(B/I^(n+1)), with transitions u_n and projections v_n to V. For each family t_n∈Γ(V_n,O) satisfying u_n^sharp(t_(n+1))=t_n, there is a unique b∈B whose canonical restrictions from Spec(B) through V and v_n equal t_n for every n. This is a scalar formal calculation and makes no assertion about sections of a finite étale cover.

proof.text: Use the combined-ideal coefficient theorem at base ideal zero and exponent one to identify ker(constantCoeff) with the variable ideal. Mathlib gives adic completeness for this ideal.

Invert the bijective finite-index restriction map k_n to obtain q_n in B/I^(n+1) from t_n. These are uniquely determined quotient classes. Naturality of ΓSpecIso and pullback.snd shows that k_n composed with the quotient transition equals the section transition composed with k_(n+1). Injectivity of k_n and compatibility of t give compatibility of q.

Take c_n to be the actual Quotient.out representative of q_n. Consecutive representatives agree modulo I^(n+1). Induction gives agreement of c_m and c_n modulo I^(m+1) for m≤n, hence modulo I^m. Apply Mathlib IsPrecomplete.prec to construct b. Its congruence to c_(n+1), together with consecutive compatibility, gives mk_(I^(n+1))(b)=q_n.

The pullback square and ΓSpecIso naturality identify the canonical restriction of b to V_n with k_n(mk(b)), hence t_n. For any other a with the same restrictions, injectivity of k_n makes mk(a)=q_n=mk(b) at every positive exponent. Project to exponent n and apply IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq to conclude a=b. All these steps are proved in the delivered Lean.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse limit of sections on punctured power series thickenings equals the multivariate power series ring
Inverse limit of global sections of punctured power series quotient thickenings is the power series ring by Hartogs
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits about Laurent series and univariate series; none identifies sections of the punctured thickenings.

Mathlib.RingTheory.AdicCompletion.Completeness provides completeness for the variable ideal; MvPowerSeries.Equiv supplies the polynomial completion equivalence. No punctured-scheme restriction result. Existing formal approximation starts with a section on V, rather than an arbitrary thickening section. Blueprint searches for quotient power series and formal sections have zero matches.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Mathlib supplies completeness; no geometric restriction comparison

theorem existsUnique_powerSeries_punctured_thickening_sections
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V n, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningTransition
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V n).appTop
        (s (n + 1)) = s n) :
    ∃! b : MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A, ∀ n,
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).inv ≫ V.ι.appTop ≫
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d) (R := A)) V n).appTop) b = s n
